title: Klaviyo Pricing Review 2026: Real Costs at Every List Size (Is It Worth It?)

facts.fact: Klaviyo's Email plan list price at 500 contacts is about $20 per month, including 5,000 sends per month.
Klaviyo's Email plan list price at 5,000 contacts is about $100 per month, including 50,000 sends per month.
Klaviyo's Email plan list price at 100,000 contacts is about $1,380 per month, including 1,000,000 sends per month.
Klaviyo's list prices are billed monthly and Klaviyo offers no annual discount.
facts.quote: _Klaviyo list prices, billed monthly (Klaviyo has no annual discount), verified October 2026._

facts.fact: Klaviyo's free tier is capped at 250 contacts and 500 email sends per month.
facts.quote: Klaviyo’s free tier caps at 250 contacts and 500 email sends per month.

facts.fact: Klaviyo SMS is an add-on to the Email plan priced at $0.01 per SMS credit plus carrier fees, about $1 per 100 texts before carrier fees.
facts.quote: at $0.01 per SMS credit plus carrier fees (about $1 per 100 texts before carrier fees)

facts.fact: Klaviyo has no combined Email plus SMS plan; SMS is sold only as an add-on to the Email plan.
facts.quote: There is no combined Email + SMS plan: SMS is an add-on to the Email plan

facts.fact: The author states Klaviyo's per-contact cost flattens out at around 25,000 contacts.
facts.quote: The break point where Klaviyo’s per-contact cost flattens out is around 25,000 contacts.

facts.fact: The author estimates Klaviyo at 5,000 contacts with 3,000 SMS sends per month costs about $130 per month plus carrier fees, versus $100 for email only.
facts.unit: USD per month plus carrier fees
facts.quote: At 5,000 contacts running modest SMS (3,000 sends per month), that’s about $130/mo plus carrier fees vs the email-only $100.

facts.fact: The author's list-price comparison shows Mailchimp Standard at $100 per month for 5,000 contacts, the same as Klaviyo's Email plan.
The author's comparison shows Mailchimp Standard at $310 per month for 25,000 contacts versus Klaviyo's $400.
The author's comparison shows MailerLite Comfort at $49 per month for 5,000 contacts.
MailerLite is 10% cheaper on annual billing, per the author.
facts.quote: MailerLite is 10% cheaper on annual billing

facts.fact: The author states Omnisend is about 20% cheaper than Klaviyo at 5,000 contacts.
facts.quote: Omnisend is about 20% cheaper at 5,000 contacts

facts.fact: The author's threshold for when Klaviyo's premium is justified is more than $10,000 per month in store revenue.
facts.quote: Are you doing more than $10,000 per month in store revenue?

facts.fact: The article was published May 13, 2026 and updated October 14, 2026.
facts.quote: By Manu A. · May 13, 2026 · 10 min read · Updated Oct 14, 2026
